While it doesn't explicitly contrast with the Founder's 18-month restriction, the inconsistency is evident from the separate tables showing 5 years vs 18 months.

The deliverable correctly gives the long-stop period as 120 days, the date as 29 August 2026, and calculates 109 days remaining from 12 May 2026 (though it notes this is a Saturday requiring adjustment).

The deliverable provides pinpoint citations for every issue, including document names and line/clause numbers (e.g., 'SPA line 49', 'Escrow lines 27, 43', 'Employment line 65', 'Client Email line 9'). The citation format is consistent and enables precise location of each provision.

The deliverable checks multiple deadlines against weekends and non-Business Days, correctly identifying: (1) Escrow deposit 17 May 2026 (Sunday) adjusted to 18 May 2026; (2) SPA conditions 29 August 2026 (Saturday) recommended adjustment to 31 August 2026; (3) Fundamental Warranties 29 June 2030 (Saturday); and (4) Non-Competition 29 June 2031 (Sunday). It applies the Escrow Agreement's Business Day definition correctly but notes the SPA lacks such definition.
